MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) where this Audio Scene is or is intended to be located.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) where this Audio Scene is or is intended to be located.

AudioSceneDescriptorsID.description: Unique identifier of this Audio Scene Descriptors instance.

AudioSceneDescriptorsTime.description: Time this Audio Scene Descriptors instance was produced.

AudioSceneDescriptorsSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Audio Scene Descriptors instance is located.

ClosedSpace.description: The Closed Space the Scene is in, placed by AudioSceneDescriptorsSpaceTime. A Basic Audio Scene Descriptors in this Scene with a Closed Space of its own keeps it for its members.

AudioObjectCount.description: Number of Audio Objects in the Audio Scene.

AudioObjects.description: Set of Audio Objects in the Audio Scene.

AudioObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Audio Object is located within the Audio Scene.

ObjectIDOrObject.description: Either the ID of a Basic Audio Object or of an Audio Object, or the Object itself.

SubAudioSceneCount.description: Number of Audio Sub-Scenes in the Audio Scene.

SubAudioScenes.description: Set of Audio Sub-Scenes in the Audio Scene.

SubAudioSceneSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Audio Sub-Scene is located within the Audio Scene.

SubASceneIDOrSubAScene.description: Either the ID of a Basic Audio Scene or of an Audio Scene, or the Scene itself.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Audio Scene Descriptors instance in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Audio Scene Descriptors instance (plain text, max 2048 characters).
